payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is a frog newly placed visibly inside the toilet bowl?
node.criteria: complete: at least one frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl in the edited image and was not there in the source. partial: a frog was added toward or partly into the bowl, but its placement inside the bowl is genuinely incomplete or ambiguous. absent: no frog has been added toward or inside the toilet. unknown: the source-to-edited evidence is insufficient to determine this. Frogs on the lid, tank, floor, or elsewhere are unrelated extras; do not downgrade a clearly fulfilled bowl placement because of them.
node.binding: The toilet bowl and any frog newly placed inside it, compared between source and edited images.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
